title: Windrow Customer Advisory Council charter
brief: Draft the charter page for the Windrow Software Customer Advisory Council, effective 2027-01-01, sponsored by Chief Product Officer Ines Carvalho. Headings, in this order: "Purpose", "Membership", "Meetings", "What the council does and does not do", "Confidentiality". Purpose: give customers a structured, regular way to shape the product roadmap and to tell us plainly what is not working. Membership: 14 seats, 12 customers and 2 Windrow product leads, chosen to reflect the customer base by size and industry; customer members serve two-year terms, renewable once, and half the customer seats rotate each year to keep continuity; the chair is Ines Carvalho and the vice chair is elected by customer members. Meetings: quarterly, two hours, held on 2027-03-10, 2027-06-09, 2027-09-08 and 2027-12-08, with an agenda sent 10 days ahead and written minutes shared within 5 business days; a quorum is 8 members including at least 6 customers. What the council does: reviews roadmap themes, tests early designs, and ranks customer-submitted requests; what it does not do: it does not approve pricing, cannot commit Windrow to a delivery date, and does not replace the normal support channel. Confidentiality: all members sign a mutual NDA before the first meeting, and roadmap material shown is confidential unless marked otherwise. Short, formal, no jargon.

edit.request: Change the number of seats to 16, with 14 customers and 2 Windrow product leads, and the quorum to 9 members including at least 7 customers. Add a fifth meeting date on 2027-02-10 as a kickoff.
